title: Audio: a library of audio parts, Revise levels, one chat widget

set.request: See requirements.md and owner-words.md: a new framework/audio/ library of pure audio parts (mic chooser, level meter, recorder, streams, push-to-talk), transcription separate from dictation, refinement at levels, three composed demos, visibility into Whisper, refinement wired into the real dictate path, one chat widget for drawer and sheet.
steps: Scope: read Dictate, playground, prompt-refine, item-ui, mobile-nav
Name the module and classes (naming skill)
Minion A: audio/ parts + transcribe engines + demos
Minion B: refinement levels wired into the dictate path + playground visibility
Minion C: one chat widget for drawer and sheet (with mobile-nav)
Smoke test, merge, screenshots at 1920 and 400
